name: 12-merge-messages-head
description: mergeMessages (prompt-converters.js:827-954) on the non-strict defaults, which is the shape `postProcessPrompt`'s MERGE branch uses. It pins the four rules that run before the squash pass, in the order the reference runs them: the example_assistant prefix (:854-858, skipped here because the turn already starts with the character name), the example_user prefix (:859-863), the generic `name + ': '` prefix for a non-system named turn (:864-868), and the tools-off demotion of a `tool` turn to `user` (:869-871) plus the `delete` of tool_calls/tool_call_id (:887-890). The squash pass (:894-900) then folds the three consecutive user turns into one, joined with '\n\n' -- and note the merged turn keeps the FIRST turn's extra keys, which is why the surviving `tool_calls` key is the assistant's, not the demoted tool turn's. `name` is deleted from every message (:886). The sentinel supplies startsWithGroupName, and `groupNames` holds a member whose name the example_assistant rule would accept.
